# Find Center of Star Graph.

@example Node 3 lies on both edges, and nodes 1 and 2 on one each.
[[3,1],[2,3]]
=> 3

@example Every edge has a 6 in it, sometimes first and sometimes second.
[[4,6],[6,1],[3,6],[6,5],[2,6]]
=> 6

@example Here the center is written first in every pair.
[[7,5],[7,2],[7,8],[7,1],[7,3],[7,6],[7,4]]
=> 7

# The smallest stars, with the center at each place in the first two
# edges: first in both.
[[2,1],[2,3]]
=> 2

# First in edges[0], second in edges[1].
[[1,3],[2,1]]
=> 1

# Second in edges[0], first in edges[1].
[[2,3],[3,1]]
=> 3

# Second in both.
[[3,2],[1,2]]
=> 2

# The center is node 1, the smallest number.
[[6,1],[1,3],[1,7],[4,1],[2,1],[1,5]]
=> 1

# The center is node n, the largest number (a degree table needs n + 1 slots).
[[1,9],[8,9],[2,9],[7,9],[3,9],[6,9],[4,9],[5,9]]
=> 9

# Random small cases from gen.c (lc check --regen makes them). Full-size
# cases (n = 10^5) are too large to store here.
@gen 3 small
[[3,7],[7,8],[4,7],[7,6],[5,7],[2,7],[1,7]]
=> 7

@gen 9 small
[[6,2],[2,1],[2,5],[2,3],[7,2],[2,4]]
=> 2

@gen 13 small
[[3,1],[2,1],[4,1],[5,1]]
=> 1

@gen 15 small
[[1,6],[2,6],[4,6],[3,6],[5,6]]
=> 6

@gen 18 small
[[5,1],[4,5],[3,5],[2,5],[6,5]]
=> 5

@gen 21 small
[[1,3],[3,4],[2,3],[3,5]]
=> 3

@gen 26 small
[[5,8],[5,6],[4,5],[3,5],[1,5],[5,7],[2,5]]
=> 5
